description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [High Quick Cast 1], [Awoken Viera Warrior], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode II (Ice, Lightning)] and [Flowing Mist Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Viera Warrior
description.text: Ice and Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Eruyt Feat after using Ice or Lightning abilities

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] after using a Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Flowing Mist Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Flowing Mist (Ice/Lightning) after using three Ice or Lightning abilities if the triggering ability deals Ice/Lightning damage

description.name: Flowing Mist (Ice)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], grants [Attach Ice] and [Buff Ice 10% (15s)] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Buff Ice 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Flowing Mist (Lightning)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], grants [Attach Lightning] and [Buff Lightning 10% (15s)] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Buff Lightning 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 10%, cumulable
